description: This file defines classes and enums related to PDF font descriptors within the PDFsharp library, including the PdfFontDescriptor class and the PdfFontDescriptorFlags enum, which specify font metrics, attributes, and flags for PDF font handling.

classes.name: PdfFontDescriptor
classes.description: Represents a PDF font descriptor with font metrics and attributes, capable of preparing font data for PDF output.

classes.name: PdfFontDescriptorFlags
classes.description: Flags indicating font characteristics such as fixed pitch, serif, symbolic, script, italic, all caps, small caps, and force bold.

methods.name: FlagsFromDescriptor
methods.description: Generates font descriptor flags based on the properties of an OpenTypeDescriptor.

methods.name: CreateEmbeddedFontSubsetName
methods.description: Creates a unique six-letter uppercase font subset name based on a GUID and the original font name.
